'''Drrlirm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] that lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was an expert on surviving the wilderness of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and worked as an informant for [[Queen/Legends|queen]] [[Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

[[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 years ABY]], Kylantha asked Drrlirm and his friends [[Orrekazzapirr]] and [[Imarrra]] to travel to their home world Kashyyyk and investigate the news that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial force]] stationed on the planet was assisting the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. On Kashyyyk, Drrlirm and his friends tried to investigate the Trandoshan's slaving operations in one of their camps near [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], but were ambushed and overpowered. Drrlirm was the only one that escaped, severely wounded. He stayed in the jungles for days, trying to regain his strength to get back to Kachirho. He was found by an adventurer sent by queen Kylantha, as the queen had been worried after she hadn't received any news from the Wookiees. The adventurer escorted Drrlirm back to Kachircho, fending off several Trandoshan slavers on their way. Then the spacer went on to find Orrekazzapirr and Imarra, which were eventually freed from the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Behind the scenes==
Drrlirm was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. During the quest [[:w:c:swg:To the Queen's Aid|To the Queen's Aid]] the player was sent to Kashyyyk to search for the missing Wookiees. Drrlirm appeared in the jungle near Kachirho and had to be escorted back to the city. On the way, several Trandoshan slaver NPCs spawned and have to be killed quickly before they could kill Drrlirm.
